grammar.title: 否定疑问句（Negative questions）
grammar.structure: 否定助动词/be + 主语 + 动词?（如 Can't you …? / Aren't you …? / Didn't you …?）
grammar.definition: 把 not 缩在助动词/be 前构成简略否定疑问句，可表示惊异、责怪、请求、邀请或建议。回答仍按事实用 Yes/No，译法较特殊。
grammar.usage: Can't you wait a moment? 你不能等一会儿吗？Isn't it hot here? 这里难道不热吗？

examples.en: Can't you wait till this afternoon?
examples.zh: 您就不能等到今天下午吗？

examples.en: Can't the dentist see me now?
examples.zh: 牙科医生现在就不能给我看一下吗？

grammar.title: 一般现在时 vs 一般过去时（习惯 vs 过去一次）
grammar.structure: 一般现在时：主语 + 动词原形/三单（every …）；一般过去时：主语 + 动词过去式（last … / … ago）
grammar.definition: 一般现在时表经常性、习惯性动作（常与 every year/day 连用）；一般过去时表过去某时发生的一次性动作（常与 last year, yesterday, … ago 连用）。
grammar.usage: 对比「经常做」与「过去做一次」。

examples.en: She buys a new car every year.
She bought a new car last year.

lines.speaker: MR CROFT
lines.en: Good morning, nurse. I want to see the dentist, please.
lines.zh: 早上好，护士。我想见牙科医生，麻烦您。
lines.note: I want to see sb. 想见某人。

lines.speaker: MR CROFT
lines.en: Yes, it is. It's very urgent. I feel awful. I have a terrible toothache.
lines.zh: 是的，很急。我难受极了。我牙痛得要命。
lines.note: terrible toothache 可怕的牙痛；feel awful 难受极了。

lines.speaker: NURSE
lines.en: Can you come at 10 a.m. on Monday, April 24th?
lines.zh: 您在 4 月 24 日星期一上午 10 点钟来行吗？
lines.note: 英语时间由小到大：10 a.m. on Monday, April 24th。

lines.speaker: MR CROFT
lines.en: I must see the dentist now, nurse.
lines.zh: 我必须现在就见牙科医生，护士。
lines.note: must 比 want 语气更强。

lines.speaker: NURSE
lines.en: The dentist is very busy at the moment. Can you come at 2:00 p.m.?
lines.zh: 牙科医生这会儿很忙。您下午 2 点钟来行吗？
lines.note: at the moment 此时/这会儿；p.m. 下午。

lines.speaker: MR CROFT
lines.en: That's very late. Can't the dentist see me now?
lines.zh: 那就太晚了。牙科医生现在就不能给我看一下吗？
lines.note: Can't …? 否定疑问句，表惊讶/请求。

lines.en: I'm afraid that he can't, Mr Croft. Can't you wait till this afternoon?
lines.zh: 恐怕不能，克罗夫特先生。您就不能等到今天下午吗？
lines.note: 否定疑问句表委婉请求/嗔怪；till 直到。

text.title: She bought a new car last year.

drill.zh: ……（一般现在时）每……。——……（一般过去时）……。（对照「经常做」与「过去做一次」）

slots.en: She buys a new car — every year — bought a new car last year
slots.zh: 她买一辆新车 — 每年 — 去年买了一辆

slots.en: She airs the room — every day — aired it this morning

slots.en: He often loses his pen — (often) — lost his pen this morning
slots.zh: 他常丢钢笔 — （常常）— 今天早上丢了

slots.en: She always listens to the news — (always) — listened to the news yesterday
slots.zh: 她总听新闻 — （总是）— 昨天听了

slots.en: She empties this basket — every day — emptied it yesterday

answers: She buys a new car every year. She bought a new car last year.
She airs the room every day. She aired it this morning.

questions.q: What time of day is it, do you think? How do you know?
questions.zh: 你认为现在是几点钟？你怎么知道的？
questions.a: It is morning. We know because Nurse and Mr Croft say 'Good morning' and the nurse offers a Monday '10 a.m.' appointment.
questions.aZh: 是早上。因为护士和克罗夫特先生互道「早上好」，护士还约了上午 10 点的时间。
questions.hint: 听 Good morning 与 10 a.m.

questions.q: Does Mr Croft have an appointment with the dentist?
questions.zh: 克罗夫特先生和牙医约好了吗？
questions.hint: Nurse: Do you have an appointment? Mr Croft: No, I don't.

questions.q: Why does Mr Croft say it is urgent?
questions.zh: 克罗夫特先生为什么说很急？
questions.a: Because he has a terrible toothache and feels awful — he must see the dentist now.
questions.aZh: 因为他牙痛得要命、难受极了，必须现在就看牙医。
questions.hint: It's very urgent. I feel awful. I have a terrible toothache.

questions.q: What time does the nurse finally suggest?
questions.zh: 护士最后建议什么时间来？

questions.q: Why does the nurse say 'Can't you wait till this afternoon?' as a negative question?
questions.zh: 护士为什么用否定疑问句「您就不能等到今天下午吗」？
questions.a: A negative question like Can't you wait? softens a request or expresses mild reproach — she is politely urging him to wait, not really asking whether he is unable to.
questions.aZh: 否定疑问句（Can't you wait?）能委婉地提出请求或带点嗔怪——她是客气地劝他等，并非真问他「能不能」。
questions.hint: 否定疑问句常表请求/惊讶，回答按事实来。

questions.zh: ……（一般现在时）每……。——……（一般过去时）……。（对照经常做与过去做一次）
questions.a: She buys a new car every year. She bought a new car last year.
questions.aZh: 她每年买一辆新车。她去年买了一辆新车。
questions.hint: 前句表习惯用现在时，后句表过去用过去式。

title: Terrible toothache / She bought a new car last year.
subtitle: 可怕的牙痛 / 她去年买了一辆新车。

lead.question: 你牙疼得要命冲进诊所，护士问「约好了吗、急吗、能下午来吗」，你却说「我的牙痛可等不了」——这番对话你会用英语怎么讲？又会怎么用否定疑问句表达「您就不能等等吗」？
lead.warmup: 先别看课文。想象克罗夫特先生一大早就捂着腮帮冲进诊所：想见牙医、没预约、非常急。护士两次改时间，最后用否定疑问句 Can't you wait till this afternoon? 劝他等。这里有两个重点：① 否定疑问句（Can't you …?）表请求/责怪；② 一般现在时 vs 一般过去时对照（buys every year / bought last year）。第 78 课把这种「经常做 / 过去做一次」的对照套进问答。
goals: 能用 I want to see the dentist / have an appointment 表达看诊与预约
理解并会使用否定疑问句 Can't you …?（请求/责怪）
区分一般现在时与一般过去时（every year vs last year）
掌握 urgent、toothache、till、at the moment 等词
lead.summary: 第 77 课：克罗夫特先生牙疼难忍去诊所，没预约、说很急，护士先约周一上午 10 点、又改下午 2 点，先生嫌晚，护士用否定疑问句 Can't you wait till this afternoon? 劝他等，先生答「我倒能等，可牙痛等不了」。第 78 课用 She buys a new car every year. / She bought a new car last year. 对照一般现在时与过去时。
lead.tips: ① 否定疑问句 Can't you wait? 表请求/惊讶，回答仍按事实用 Yes/No；② I want to see … 比 I must see … 语气弱，must 更强；③ at the moment 此时/这会儿；④ till 直到；⑤ a.m./p.m. 上/下午；⑥ 一般现在时表习惯（every year），过去时表过去一次（last year）。
